notes.title: "Millennium Strategy" Trial Ended Thank You for Playing!
notes.content:
We sincerely appreciate your participation in the Millennium Strategy DEMO!
During this trial period, we have addressed the majority of technical issues and rolled out updates including multiple heroes, adversaries, and card systems. Our team remains committed to delivering an exceptional gaming experience.

Given the substantial divergence between the current trial version and the upcoming official release – driven by continuous iterative enhancements – we have decided to temporarily suspend the DEMO access.

Future testing phases will introduce significantly expanded content. Notably, we have commenced work on multi-language localization, which will be integrated into the next testing phase for global player engagement.

* English localization will be prioritized in our development pipeline, with the translated version being the first to undergo closed beta testing.

notes.title: Millennium Strategy X Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Welcome to our teahouse! We are participating in the new product festival from October 15th to October 22nd. This is a no-nonsense, fast-paced card game that focuses on combat and card playing fun! We invite you to try it out! And this demo version will still be available after the game festival ends, allowing for repeated play!
This demo opens the first level's Boss, the **Taotie**. Come and try to defeat him!

For players who have already been playing the demo:
* A series of tutorial levels have been added to the title screen.
* Some card descriptions and display effects have been optimized.
* Some game sound effects have been optimized.
* The cost of some cards has been adjusted.

MiMo Games
